blurb: BlackStack Brewing operates a taproom in a historic building dating back to 1889, offering a variety of their own brewed beers. Guests can enjoy board games, trivia nights, and a welcoming atmosphere with natural light and lounge seating. The north end of the taproom can be rented for semi-private events accommodating 50-100 standing or 40 seated guests.
extraNote: Cannot rent entire taproom, only north end · Avoid decorations with glitter, balloons, or that must be hung or taped to walls · Taproom at the historic American Can Building in St Paul’s Midway-Hamline neighborhood, next to Can-Can Wonderland. · Spring, Summer, and Fall for patio use
